_note: Config for tools/build-demo.mjs. Run from the repo root: node tools/build-demo.mjs demos/purchasing/build.json, then node demos/purchasing/verify.mjs. Index.html is the app template; JavaScript.html arrives through the HtmlService include form (inlined by includeDir). The output tokens doGet fills become the demo persona (Owner Jordan Rivera, jrivera@example.edu). Three control-scriptlet blocks are removed outright before the builder strips the remaining wrappers: the classroom-teacher notice (it names a real person), the Approver-only status options in the Management filter (an Owner sees the full list) and the Approver-only PIN Settings button. The success image (a Drive file) becomes an inline SVG, and Switch Account shows a notice instead of opening Google's account chooser. People named in source comments are swapped for roles by the hashed tables (tools/staff-aliases.mjs plus nameAliases below: keys are sha256 of the lowercased word, so this public file names no one). data.js and mock.js answer every google.script.run method the page calls.
